title: LATER: Learning Action-Conditioned Temporal Evidence Retrieval for Predictive World Models
title_zh: LATER：面向预测式世界模型的动作条件时序证据检索学习
abstract_en: Early interactions can reveal physical properties that later observations no longer show. These properties can still gov- ern the effects of future actions. Inspired by the distinction between retention and selective readout in working mem- ory and cognitive science, we introduce LATER, an action- conditioned world model built on CF-JEPA. LATER stores completed real transitions in partitioned memories that remain fixed during candidate rollouts. A response bridge queries these memories using the current state and candidate action, while multi-cut auxiliary supervision trains the memory writ- ers. On distracted Two-Stage PushT, LATER raises terminal success from 15.5% to 25.0% over reconstructed CF-JEPA. In a separate comparison across six models and two scratch- training seeds, LATER achieves the lowest mean physical readout error in both clean and distracted views, reducing along-push mean absolute error (MAE) under distractors by 20.2% relative to CF-JEPA. Controlled history interventions show that later predictions depend on earlier physical evi- dence even when query observations and actions are fixed, with larger effects during pushing than waiting.
abstract_zh: 早期交互可以揭示后来无法从观测中直接看出的物理属性，而这些属性仍会影响未来动作的结果。受工作记忆研究中信息保留与选择性读取之区分的启发，本文提出基于 CF-JEPA 的动作条件世界模型 LATER。该模型将已完成的真实状态转移写入分区记忆，并在候选动作序列的预测展开期间保持记忆不变；响应桥（response bridge）根据当前状态与候选动作检索相关证据，记忆写入模块则通过多切点辅助监督训练。在含干扰的 Two-Stage PushT 上，LATER 的最终任务成功率从复现版 CF-JEPA 的 15.5% 提升至 25.0%。在另一项涵盖六个模型、使用两个随机种子从头训练的对比中，LATER 在无干扰和有干扰的观测条件下均取得最低的平均物理属性解读误差；在有干扰时，其沿推动方向的平均绝对误差（MAE）较 CF-JEPA 降低 20.2%。受控历史干预表明，即使固定查询时的观测和动作，后续预测仍受早期物理证据影响，且这种影响在推动时比等待时更强。
key_points_zh: 将真实状态转移存入分区记忆，候选动作的预测展开不会改写这些历史证据。
响应桥（response bridge）根据当前状态和候选动作选择性读取记忆；多切点辅助监督用于训练记忆写入模块。
在含干扰的 Two-Stage PushT 上，最终任务成功率从复现版 CF-JEPA 的 15.5% 提升至 25.0%，增加 9.5 个百分点。
六模型对比中，LATER 在有无干扰时的平均物理属性解读误差均最低；有干扰时，沿推动方向的 MAE 较 CF-JEPA 降低 20.2%。
固定查询观测和动作、仅改变历史证据仍会改变预测，且影响在推动时比等待时更大。
